name: Bai Sach Chrouk
dish_kh: បាយសាច់ជ្រូក
description: Grilled marinated pork sliced thin over broken rice, served with pickled cucumbers and daikon, and a warm scallion broth. Cambodia's classic breakfast.

name: Kuy Teav Phnom Penh
dish_kh: គុយទាវភ្នំពេញ
description: Traditional Phnom Penh clear pork and seafood bone broth noodle soup, topped with minced pork, pork slices, beef balls, and fresh herbs.

name: Beef Lok Lak
dish_kh: ឡុកឡាក់សាច់គោ
description: Stir-fried cubed tender beef in savory oyster-soy sauce, served over lettuce, sliced tomatoes, cucumbers, a fried egg, and black Kampot pepper lime dip.

name: Num Banhchok Samlor Proher
dish_kh: នំបញ្ចុកសម្លប្រហើរ
description: Fresh hand-pressed fermented rice noodles submerged in a fragrant green river fish broth pounded with kroeung lemongrass paste and fresh raw vegetables.

name: Num Banhchok Samlor Kari
dish_kh: នំបញ្ចុកសម្លការី
description: Fermented Khmer rice noodles drenched in rich red chicken or fish coconut curry with sweet potatoes, bamboo shoots, and green beans.

name: Fish Amok
dish_kh: អាម៉ុកត្រី
description: Cambodia's national treasure: fresh river snakehead or catfish fillets steamed with coconut cream, kroeung lemongrass paste, egg, and noni leaves in banana-leaf cups.

name: Samlor Kako
dish_kh: សម្លកកូរ
description: Nutritious traditional soup packed with pumpkin, green papaya, bitter gourd, morning glory, toasted ground rice, fish and pork ribs.

name: Samlor Machu Kroeung
dish_kh: សម្លម្ជូរគ្រឿង
description: Cambodian sour soup seasoned with golden lemongrass paste, tamarind, beef ribs, morning glory, and holy basil.

name: Bok L'hong
dish_kh: បុកល្ហុង
description: Pounded green papaya salad with salted blue crabs, yardlong beans, dried shrimp, garlic, bird's eye chilies, fish sauce, and crushed roasted peanuts.

name: Num Pang Pate
dish_kh: នំប៉័ងសាច់ប៉ាតេ
description: Crispy French-style Cambodian baguette sandwich layered with rich pork liver pâté, Vietnamese-style ham, pickled carrots and papaya, cucumber, and chili.

name: Banh Chhev
dish_kh: បាញ់ឆែវ
description: Crisp turmeric-coconut rice crêpe folded around minced pork, small shrimp, bean sprouts, served with lettuce, herbs, and sweet-sour peanut fish sauce dip.

name: Lort Cha
dish_kh: លតឆា
description: Short pin-needle rice noodles stir-fried in sweet soy sauce with beef, bean sprouts, Chinese chives, topped with a fried egg and sweet chili dip.

name: Mi Cha
dish_kh: មីឆា
description: Stir-fried yellow egg noodles or instant mama noodles with sliced beef, Chinese greens, sweet dark soy sauce, fried duck egg, and chili garlic sauce.

name: Cha Kdao
dish_kh: ឆាក្តៅ
description: Spicy aromatic stir-fry of chicken, beef, or frog with holy basil, lemongrass kroeung, garlic, long beans, and fiery red chilies.

name: Pleah Sach Ko
dish_kh: ភ្លាសាច់គោ
description: Delicate Cambodian ceviche of rare sliced beef cured in fresh lime juice, tossed with fresh mint, shallots, lemongrass, bean sprouts, and roasted peanuts.

name: Sach Ko Jakak
dish_kh: សាច់គោចាក់កាក់
description: Charcoal-grilled beef skewers marinated in lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime, turmeric, and palm sugar, eaten with papaya pickle and baguette.

name: Cha Kdam Kampot
dish_kh: ឆាក្តាមម្រេចខ្ចីកំពត
description: Stir-fried sweet fresh crabs bursting with bunches of fragrant green Kampot peppercorns, garlic, spring onions, and oyster sauce.

name: Prahok Ktiss
dish_kh: ប្រហុកខ្ទិះ
description: Rich savory dip made from fermented fish paste (prahok), coconut milk, minced pork belly, pea eggplants, and tamarind, served with raw crunchy vegetables.

name: Num Krok
dish_kh: នំគ្រក់
description: Crispy half-sphere coconut rice pancakes with scallions, cooked on cast-iron dimple pans, dipped in sweet fish sauce.

name: Kralan
dish_kh: ក្រឡាន
description: Sticky rice mixed with black beans, grated coconut, and coconut milk, roasted slowly over charcoal inside bamboo poles.

name: Mi Hel 7 Levels
dish_kh: មីហឹរ ៧ កម្រិត
description: Spicy hot bowl noodles with 7 customizable heat levels, loaded with seafood, beef balls, mushrooms, and Korean chili paste.

name: Fresh Salmon Sashimi
dish_kh: សាស៊ីមីត្រីសាល់ម៉ុង
description: Thick slices of fresh Norwegian raw salmon served chilled with soy sauce, freshly grated wasabi, and pickled ginger.

name: Spicy Tuna Roll
dish_kh: ស៊ូស៊ីត្រីធូណា
description: Maki sushi roll filled with minced fresh raw tuna, sriracha chili mayo, cucumber, wrapped in nori seaweed and seasoned sushi rice.

name: Tonkotsu Pork Ramen
dish_kh: រ៉ាមេនសាច់ជ្រូក
description: Rich, creamy 12-hour simmered pork bone broth ramen with springy wheat noodles, chashu pork belly slices, seasoned soft-boiled egg, nori, and bamboo shoots.

name: Crispy Pork Tonkatsu
dish_kh: សាច់ជ្រូកបំពងតុងកាតស៊ូ
description: Deep-fried panko-breaded pork cutlet served with shredded cabbage, tonkatsu barbecue plum sauce, steamed Japanese rice, and miso soup.

name: Chicken Teriyaki Bento
dish_kh: បាយប្រអប់តេរីយ៉ាគី
description: Glazed pan-seared chicken thighs in sweet mirin-soy teriyaki sauce, served in a bento box with rice, salad, tamagoyaki, and gyoza.

name: Crispy Ebi Tempura
dish_kh: បង្គាបំពងតេមពួរ៉ា
description: Lightly battered, airy deep-fried tiger prawns and seasonal vegetables served with savory tentsuyu dipping sauce and grated daikon.

name: Pan-Fried Pork Gyoza
dish_kh: គាវបំពងជប៉ុន
description: Japanese dumplings stuffed with seasoned minced pork, garlic, ginger, and scallions, crisped golden on the bottom and steamed tender on top.

name: Takoyaki Octopus Balls
dish_kh: នំតាកូយ៉ាគី
description: Crispy ball-shaped wheat flour batter filled with diced octopus pieces, topped with Japanese mayo, sweet okonomi sauce, seaweed flakes, and bonito flakes.

name: Beef Udon Noodle Soup
dish_kh: មីអ៊ូដុងសាច់គោ
description: Thick chewy white wheat udon noodles in a clear dashi bonito-kelp broth topped with tender thinly sliced simmered beef and spring onions.

name: Korean Samgyeopsal (K-BBQ)
dish_kh: សាច់ជ្រូកបីជាន់អាំងកូរ៉េ
description: Thick cuts of fresh pork belly grilled sizzling at the table, wrapped in crisp lettuce leaves with garlic, perilla leaves, ssamjang paste, and kimchi.

name: Stone Bowl Bibimbap
dish_kh: បាយឆាថ្មក្តៅប៊ីប៊ីមបាប់
description: Sizzling dolsot stone bowl filled with warm rice, sauteed seasoned vegetables, marinated beef, gochujang chili paste, and a raw or fried egg that crisps the rice.

name: Spicy Tteokbokki
dish_kh: តុកបុកគីហឹរ
description: Chewy cylindrical Korean rice cakes and fish cakes simmered in a sweet, fiery red gochujang chili broth topped with boiled egg and melted cheese.

name: Kimchi Jjigae (Kimchi Stew)
dish_kh: ស៊ុបគីមឈី
description: Bubbling hot Korean spicy stew made with fermented aged kimchi, fatty pork belly, soft tofu, scallions, and anchovy broth.

name: Korean Crispy Fried Chicken
dish_kh: មាន់បំពងកូរ៉េ
description: Double-fried extra crunchy chicken glazed in sweet and spicy Yangnyeom red sauce or honey soy garlic sauce, served with pickled radish.

name: Beef Bulgogi
dish_kh: សាច់គោប៊ុលហ្គូហ្គី
description: Thinly shaved tender beef marinated in sweet soy sauce, grated Asian pear, sesame oil, and garlic, pan-grilled with sweet onions.

name: Korean Kimbap
dish_kh: បាយរុំសារ៉ាយគីមបាប់
description: Rolled rice in nori seaweed seasoned with sesame oil, filled with yellow pickled radish, spinach, carrots, egg, and ham or bulgogi beef.

name: Sundubu Jjigae (Soft Tofu Stew)
dish_kh: ស៊ុបតៅហ៊ូទន់កូរ៉េ
description: Fiery Korean stew with uncurdled silky soft tofu, clams, shrimp, and an egg cracked in raw into the boiling earthenware pot.

name: Steamed Siu Mai Dumplings
dish_kh: ឌីមសាំគាវសាច់ជ្រូក
description: Classic Cantonese open-topped dim sum dumplings filled with minced pork, shrimp, and black mushrooms, garnished with crab roe.

name: Xiao Long Bao (Soup Dumplings)
dish_kh: ស៊ាវឡុងប៉ាវ
description: Delicate Shanghai steamed buns pleated with translucent skins, holding juicy seasoned pork meatballs and piping hot savory soup broth inside.

name: Char Siu Bao (BBQ Pork Buns)
dish_kh: នំប៉ាវសាច់ក្រហម
description: Fluffy, pillowy white steamed buns stuffed with sweet and savory Cantonese caramelized barbecue pork.

name: Peking Roasted Duck
dish_kh: ទាខ្វៃប៉េកាំង
description: Famous Chinese roasted duck with crackling crispy skin and tender meat, served sliced with paper-thin pancakes, hoisin sauce, and scallions.

name: Sichuan Mala Hot Pot
dish_kh: ស៊ុបហឹរចិនម៉ាឡា
description: Sichuan style tongue-numbing spicy hot pot simmering with red chili peppers, Sichuan peppercorns, sliced beef, enoki mushrooms, and lotus root.

name: Cantonese Chow Mein
dish_kh: មីឆាចិន
description: Crispy pan-fried egg noodles smothered in a glossy savory brown sauce with sliced chicken, shrimp, bok choy, and shiitake mushrooms.

name: Wonton Egg Noodle Soup
dish_kh: មីគាវសាច់ជ្រូក
description: Springy thin egg noodles in a clear chicken broth with delicate boiled shrimp and pork wontons, bok choy, and roasted garlic oil.

name: Mapo Tofu
dish_kh: ម៉ាផូតៅហ៊ូ
description: Fiery Sichuan dish of soft silken tofu cubes simmered in a spicy, numbing chili-bean paste sauce with minced beef or pork and Sichuan pepper.

name: Tom Yum Goong
dish_kh: ស៊ុបតុមយ៉ាំបង្គា
description: Thailand's iconic hot and sour soup infused with fragrant lemongrass, galangal, kaffir lime leaves, fresh river shrimp, mushrooms, and chili paste.

name: Pad Thai Goong
dish_kh: មីឆាថៃផាត់ថៃ
description: Stir-fried rice noodles in tangy tamarind-palm sugar sauce with fresh shrimp, pressed tofu, egg, bean sprouts, crushed peanuts, and fresh lime.

name: Som Tum Thai (Green Papaya Salad)
dish_kh: បុកល្ហុងថៃ
description: Crisp green papaya strips pounded in clay mortar with garlic, bird's eye chilies, green beans, tomatoes, lime juice, palm sugar, and roasted peanuts.

name: Thai Green Chicken Curry
dish_kh: ការីបៃតងសាច់មាន់
description: Creamy aromatic coconut curry cooked with green chili paste, chicken slices, pea eggplants, bamboo shoots, and fresh sweet Thai basil leaves.

name: Mango Sticky Rice (Khao Niew Mamuang)
dish_kh: បាយដំណើបស្វាយទុំ
description: Warm sweetened glutinous rice infused with rich salted coconut cream, paired with fresh chilled slices of sweet ripe mango.

name: Pad Krapow Gai (Holy Basil Chicken)
dish_kh: បាយឆាក្រវ៉ាន់សាច់មាន់
description: Fiery wok-tossed minced chicken with lots of fresh holy basil, garlic, and red chilies, served over jasmine rice with a crispy fried sunny-side-up egg.

name: Vietnamese Beef Pho (Pho Bo)
dish_kh: ហ្វឺសាច់គោ
description: Fragrant cinnamon-star anise beef bone broth simmered for 10 hours with flat rice noodles, rare beef slices, beef balls, fresh mint, cilantro, and bean sprouts.

name: Vietnamese Chicken Pho (Pho Ga)
dish_kh: ហ្វឺសាច់មាន់
description: Lighter, clean clear chicken bone broth with tender shredded poached chicken, fresh herbs, scallions, lime, and thin flat rice noodles.

name: Banh Mi Thit (Vietnamese Baguette)
dish_kh: នំប៉័ងវៀតណាម
description: Feathery crisp baguette loaded with liver pâté, Vietnamese cold cuts (cha lua), pickled carrots, daikon, fresh cilantro, cucumber, and chili mayo.

name: Fresh Spring Rolls (Goi Cuon)
dish_kh: គួងស្រស់វៀតណាម
description: Healthy translucent rice paper rolls stuffed with boiled shrimp, pork belly, rice vermicelli, mint, and fresh lettuce, dipped in hoisin-peanut sauce.

name: Crispy Fried Spring Rolls (Cha Gio)
dish_kh: ណែមបំពងវៀតណាម
description: Golden crunchy deep-fried rice paper rolls filled with minced pork, wood ear mushrooms, carrot, and glass noodles, served with sweet nuoc cham dip.

name: Bun Cha Hanoi
dish_kh: ប៊ុនឆាហាណូយ
description: Hanoi specialty of grilled pork patties and pork belly in sweet savory fish sauce broth, served with cool rice vermicelli noodles and fresh herbs.

name: Wood-Fired Pizza Margherita
dish_kh: ភីហ្សាម៉ាហ្គើរីតា
description: Classic Neapolitan pizza featuring San Marzano tomato sauce, fresh creamy buffalo mozzarella, sweet fresh basil leaves, and extra virgin olive oil.

name: Pepperoni Pizza
dish_kh: ភីហ្សាភិបភើរ៉ូនី
description: Crispy thin-crust pizza loaded with melted mozzarella cheese, tangy tomato marinara, and spicy cured beef or pork pepperoni slices.

name: Creamy Pasta Carbonara
dish_kh: ប៉ាស្តាកាបូណារ៉ា
description: Rich Italian spaghetti tossed with crispy cured pork (pancetta or bacon), eggs, creamy Parmesan cheese, and coarse cracked black pepper.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
dish_kh: ស្ប៉ាហ្គេតទីសាច់គោ
description: Traditional Italian spaghetti tossed with a slow-cooked ragu meat sauce made with minced beef, tomatoes, garlic, red wine, and herbs.

name: Classic Lasagna al Forno
dish_kh: នំឡាសាញ៉ា
description: Layers of tender pasta sheets baked with rich ground beef Bolognese, silky creamy béchamel sauce, and golden bubbly melted mozzarella cheese.

name: Classic Bacon Cheeseburger
dish_kh: ប៊ឺហ្គឺសាច់គោឈីស
description: Grilled 100% beef patty topped with melted cheddar cheese, crispy smoked bacon, lettuce, tomato, pickles, and burger sauce on a toasted brioche bun.

name: Crispy American Fried Chicken
dish_kh: មាន់បំពងស្រួយអាមេរិក
description: Southern buttermilk marinated chicken coated in seasoned flour and deep-fried golden brown, served with crispy french fries and coleslaw.

name: Australian Ribeye Steak
dish_kh: ស្តេកសាច់គោអូស្ត្រាលី
description: Juicy, marble-rich Australian ribeye steak seared medium with butter and rosemary, served with french fries, green salad, and peppercorn sauce.

name: British Fish and Chips
dish_kh: ត្រីបំពងនិងដំឡូងបារាំង
description: Flaky white fish fillets dipped in golden crispy beer batter, served with thick-cut chips (french fries), tartar sauce, and lemon wedges.

name: French Butter Croissant
dish_kh: ក្រូសង់ប៊័របារាំង
description: Authentic multi-layered laminated French pastry made with pure European butter, baked golden brown, crisp and flaky on the outside and tender inside.

name: Crispy French Baguette
dish_kh: នំប៉័ងបារាំង
description: Traditional long French bread baked with a hard, crunchy crust and open, airy, chewy crumb, perfect for sandwiches or butter.

name: French Steak Frites
dish_kh: ស្តេកបារាំងដំឡូងបំពង
description: Bistro classic pan-seared tender beef steak with café de Paris herb butter or green peppercorn sauce, served with thin crispy french fries.

name: Duck Confit (Confit de Canard)
dish_kh: សាច់ទាចៀនក្រៀមបារាំង
description: Tender duck leg slow-cooked submerged in its own fat until succulent, then pan-seared with golden crackling skin, served with roasted potatoes.

name: Street Tacos (Carne Asada / Pollo)
dish_kh: តាកូសាច់គោ
description: Warm soft corn tortillas filled with charred grilled marinated beef or chicken, diced white onions, cilantro, fresh lime, and spicy salsa verde.

name: Loaded Burrito
dish_kh: ប៊ូរីតូសាច់គោ
description: Large warm flour tortilla rolled tightly around seasoned Mexican rice, black beans, grilled beef or pork, salsa, cheddar cheese, and sour cream.

name: Cheesy Quesadilla
dish_kh: នំកេសាឌីយ៉ាឈីស
description: Crispy pan-toasted flour tortilla folded over melted Jack and cheddar cheeses, seasoned chicken or beef, served with pico de gallo and guacamole.

name: Tortilla Chips & Guacamole
dish_kh: ណាចូសនិងទឹកផ្លែបឺរ
description: Crunchy salted corn tortilla chips served with fresh mashed Hass avocados, lime juice, cilantro, tomatoes, and salsa dip.

name: Butter Chicken (Murgh Makhani)
dish_kh: ការីមាន់ប៊័របែបឥណ្ឌា
description: Tender tandoori-roasted chicken pieces simmered in a silky, mildly sweet and spiced tomato, butter, and heavy cream curry sauce.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
dish_kh: ការីមាន់ធីកា
description: Marinated grilled chicken chunks in a rich, deeply spiced tomato and onion gravy spiced with garam masala, fenugreek, and cumin.

name: Lamb Biryani
dish_kh: បាយប៊ីរយ៉ានីសាច់ចៀម
description: Fragrant long-grain basmati rice layered with spiced tender lamb pieces, saffron, fried onions, and whole spices, served with cool cucumber raita.

name: Garlic Butter Naan
dish_kh: នំប៉័ងណានខ្ទឹមស
description: Traditional Indian flatbread baked against the searing clay walls of a tandoor oven, brushed lavishly with melted butter and roasted minced garlic.

name: Crispy Vegetable Samosas
dish_kh: សារម៉ូសាបន្លែ
description: Golden deep-fried triangular pastry pockets stuffed with spiced potatoes, green peas, cumin, and coriander, served with sweet mint chutney.

name: Halal Chicken Shawarma Wrap
dish_kh: សាច់សាវ៉ាម៉ាមាន់
description: Thinly shaved spit-roasted chicken wrapped inside warm pita bread with garlic toum sauce, pickled turnip, cucumber, and french fries.

name: Halal Mixed Grill Platter
dish_kh: សាច់អាំងចម្រុះហាឡាល់
description: Generous platter of charcoal-grilled lamb seekh kebabs, chicken shish taouk skewers, and beef kofta served over saffron rice and pita bread.

name: Crispy Falafel with Hummus
dish_kh: ហ្វាឡាហ្វែលនិងហ៊ូមូស
description: Golden deep-fried balls of ground chickpeas and herbs served over creamy blended tahini-chickpea hummus with warm pita bread.

name: Salmon Poke Bowl
dish_kh: ផូគីប៊ូលត្រីសាល់ម៉ុង
description: Hawaiian bowl of sushi rice topped with cubed fresh raw salmon, edamame beans, ripe avocado, seaweed salad, cucumber, and sesame-soy dressing.

name: Mediterranean Quinoa Salad
dish_kh: សាឡាដគីណ័រមេឌីទែរ៉ាណេ
description: Wholesome salad of cooked fluffy quinoa, cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, kalamata olives, feta cheese, and lemon extra virgin olive oil vinaigrette.

name: Vegan Tofu Buddha Bowl
dish_kh: ប៊ូដាប៊ូលបួស
description: Nutrient-dense plant-based bowl loaded with roasted sweet potatoes, crispy air-fried spiced tofu cubes, steamed broccoli, chickpeas, and peanut tahini sauce.

name: Cambodian Iced Milk Coffee (Kafe Toek Doh Ko)
dish_en: cambodian iced milk coffee (kafe toek doh ko)
dish_kh: កាហ្វេទឹកដោះគោទឹកកក
description: Strong dark drip coffee brewed slow, stirred with sweet condensed milk, and poured over tall glass packed with crushed ice. Cambodia's daily fuel.

name: Brown Sugar Boba Milk Tea
dish_kh: តែគុជស្ករក្រហម
description: Fresh milk combined with slow-cooked warm brown sugar syrup and chewy tapioca pearls, creating caramel tiger stripes on the cup.

name: Uji Matcha Latte
dish_kh: ម៉ាតឆាឡាតេ
description: Whisked ceremonial Japanese green tea matcha poured over silky steamed or iced milk with a touch of sweetness.

name: Passion Fruit Soda
dish_kh: ទឹកផាសិនសូដា
description: Refreshing tropical beverage of real tart passion fruit seeds and juice mixed with sparkling soda water, lime, and crushed ice.

name: Fresh Avocado Smoothie
dish_kh: ទឹកផ្លែបឺរក្រឡុក
description: Creamy decadent smoothie made from ripe avocados blended with sweet milk, ice, and condensed milk.

name: Korean Mango Bingsu
dish_kh: ប៊ីងស៊ូផ្លែស្វាយកូរ៉េ
description: Fluffy, cloud-like shaved frozen milk snow piled high with fresh sweet mango cubes, vanilla ice cream scoop, and sweet condensed milk drizzle.

name: Italian Gelato Cup
dish_kh: ការ៉េមជេឡាតូអ៊ីតាលី
description: Artisan slow-churned dense Italian gelato in flavors like pistachio, dark chocolate, salted caramel, and hazelnut.

name: Portuguese Egg Tart
dish_kh: នំអេកថាត
description: Flaky caramelized puff pastry tart shells filled with creamy, rich egg custard baked until blistered dark golden brown.

name: Belgian Waffle with Ice Cream
dish_kh: នំវ៉ាហ្វលការ៉េម
description: Warm crisp Belgian waffle with deep pockets, topped with vanilla gelato scoop, chocolate drizzle, and fresh strawberry slices.
